title: The ShortPixel Image Optimizer – Optimize Images, Convert WebP & AVIF plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored…
description: The ShortPixel Image Optimizer plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in all versions up to and including 6.6.1. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping of the 'comment' parameter. Exploitation requires the administrator to enable the 'Deliver WebP/AVIF images using the ShortPixel CDN' option, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts via crafted comments. These scripts execute when users access the affected pages.
